headline: RBI Governor warns banks about AI-driven cyber risks
hook: RBI flags rising AI-based banking threats

The central bank is concerned that sophisticated AI tools are being used to compromise financial security and customer data. Banks are being urged to strengthen their digital infrastructure and cybersecurity protocols to mitigate these evolving risks. This focus on operational resilience highlights the growing regulatory scrutiny on the digital transformation of the Indian banking sector.
